question: Which causal source intervals supply the dominant native-pattern value changes read by L11H1/H3 and L15H5?

authority.finding: Base-pattern value transport carries 90.6/99.0% of auxiliary behavior and 86.0/88.9% of Q8; pattern change is secondary and interaction <=2.1%.

frozen_design.population: The same 27 jointly capable v10 rows and ordered L9-core/L11/L15 intervention context.
frozen_design.cells: For each source group and each auxiliary layer, compute P_base[:,source] delta_V[source] for only the frozen selected heads at all causal destinations.
frozen_design.arms: All 32 subsets of the five source groups, installed jointly in L11 and L15; two complete single-layer value arms; one complete all-factor reference; and native self-clamp.
frozen_design.selection: The atlas may identify a smallest sufficient source subset, but no resulting subset is promoted until zero-fit confirmation on a new capable bank.

predictions.pred_a_authority_partition_value_replay_: Hashes, exhaustive source partition, per-layer value closure, parent all-value and complete replay, self-clamp, finite metrics, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_at_least_one_small_source_program: At least one subset of at most two source groups retains at least 75% of all-value behavior and 75% of all-value Q8 norm in both panels, with cosine at least .95.
predictions.pred_c_source_program_is_panel_stable: The same smallest sufficient subset is selected in A1 and A2 under the frozen lexicographic objective.
predictions.pred_d_both_auxiliary_layers_have_materi: The complete L11-only and L15-only value programs each carry at least 10% behavior or Q8 norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_exact_subset_inventory: All 32 source subsets and both layer arms are evaluated with no fit, gradients, rank search, or model update.

decision: Screen freezes the smallest sufficient source subset for fresh confirmation and c_v/c_proj compilation. Null retains the full five-source value program and redirects to layer-specific source interactions without changing the confirmed head circuit.
